waste_items.reuse_possibility: Can be washed and refilled, converted into plant pots, or used for DIY home projects.
waste_items.recycling_possibility: High. Widely accepted by most curbside recycling programs.
waste_items.environmental_concern: Takes hundreds of years to break down and fragments into microplastics that harm ecosystems.

waste_items.reuse_possibility: Can be resold, donated, or repurposed as an offline camera, media player, or smart home controller.
waste_items.recycling_possibility: High via specialized e-waste recycling collection points or retailer trade-in programs.
waste_items.environmental_concern: Contains toxic heavy metals such as lead, mercury, and cadmium that can leach into soil and groundwater if landfilled.

waste_items.reuse_possibility: Can be used directly as garden fertilizer, plant feed, or added to home compost bins.
waste_items.recycling_possibility: High via municipal organic waste collection (green bins) or backyard composting.
waste_items.environmental_concern: Releases methane, a potent greenhouse gas, if buried anaerobically in standard landfills.

action_plans.separation: Rinse out any liquids and crush the bottle. Separate from non-recyclable trash and place in the plastics sorting bin.
action_plans.reuse: Wash thoroughly and use as plant pots, seedling starters, or DIY storage containers for small items.
action_plans.recycling: Place in curbside recycling bins or drop off at local plastic recycling collection points.
action_plans.handling: Ensure the bottle is clean and dry to prevent contamination of other recyclable materials. Reattach the cap if local guidelines permit.
action_plans.waste_reduction: Switch to a durable, reusable water bottle or flask to minimize the purchase of single-use plastic bottles.

action_plans.separation: Keep isolated from standard household trash and standard recycling bins to prevent hazardous leaching and fire risks.
action_plans.reuse: Perform a factory reset to wipe personal data, then donate, sell, or repurpose the phone as a dedicated media player, dashcam, or smart home controller.
action_plans.recycling: Drop off at specialized e-waste collection centers, certified electronics recycling points, or participate in retailer trade-in programs.
action_plans.handling: Handle with care to prevent battery damage. Keep in a cool, dry place prior to disposal and protect the battery terminals if removed.
action_plans.waste_reduction: Extend the lifecycle of existing phones through protective cases, battery replacements, and choosing repair over replacement.

action_plans.separation: Collect separately from inorganic waste, plastics, and non-compostable packaging immediately after food prep or consumption.
action_plans.reuse: Steep in water to make a nutrient-rich potassium tea for house plants, or chop and mix directly into garden soil.
action_plans.recycling: Dispose of in municipal organic/green waste bins or process in home backyard compost bins or worm farms.
action_plans.handling: Store in a sealed kitchen caddy or freeze peels until collection day to prevent fruit flies and bad odors.
action_plans.waste_reduction: Purchase bananas in realistic quantities to avoid food waste, and use ripe bananas in cooking or freezing before spoilage occurs.
